reviews.title: Fantastic financial decision expensive isnt always better.
reviews.comment: Quick simple install and has !ALL THE NEED BRACKETS SCREWS AND THINGS NEED!. So far i love it, cheap, simple, nice to look at, and best of all so far the mix of the thermal compound they supplied with the cooler. "My cpu is the coolest its been in any of my builds" between liquid cooled ryzen builds, and intel builds. The i9 i'm currently using hasnt reached temps higher than 78c, the last i9 build i made liquid cooled same test would hit 84c
reviews.author: No life

reviews.title: Calidad, rendimiento
reviews.comment: Para los que aun tienen disipador de stock de Intel o AMD recomiendo mucho este tipo de disipadores. Logre bajar(en ayuda de una mejor pasta termica) casi 20 grados de la temperatura de mi CPU, vivo en un clima bastante caliente y no he tenido mas alzas en las temperaturas en días calurosos. 20/10
reviews.author: Bryan

reviews.title: Runs Cool! Best bang for the buck!
reviews.comment: Better than an AM4 stock cooler. Comes with hardware for am4, am5 and intel cpu's, plus it has brackets for a 2nd fan if you need more airflow. I recommend getting an extra tube of Thermal Paste. It comes with some in a little tin packet but barely enough for 1 install, however it wasn't very consistent.
reviews.author: cpuupgrades

reviews.title: Keep it cooler, bro!
reviews.comment: I used this to cool a rebuild I did of a friends computer. It was very easy to install. It was quieter than the other fans on the build, so it didn't affect fan volume much. It keeps temperatures low and feels pretty heavy duty. The fans are very easy to bend, so be careful when installing. Its color is black. Nailed it.
reviews.author: Derek Herbert
